verdict.rationale: Fern Agent automations can review reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries, and analytics, then report findings and open a PR with suggested changes — a form of AI-generated insight/suggestion from the product's own usage data. Ask Fern also surfaces cited answers from indexed docs content. However this is scoped narrowly to documentation-site analytics rather than broader product data, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of Fern Agent's insight quality. Missing for 10: evidence of insights across general business/product data (not just docs analytics), independent verification of automation quality, and UI/dashboard examples of surfaced insights.
